post.body_html:
The problem

RocketSaaS runs a high volume of calls: discovery sessions, client strategy meetings, podcast recordings, and kick-offs. Each one generates raw material—market signals, buyer pain points, positioning cues, content angles.

Turning that material into something useful used to be manual. Jamie, Director of Strategy, would re-listen to a handful of calls, build a meta prompt, and piece together an analysis in ChatGPT. Doing it well took 30–60 minutes per session, so it happened monthly at most and only for a few calls.

Time wasn’t the only issue. Even with a consistent prompt, outputs varied by call. There was no guarantee the analysis would surface the same categories, use the same structure, or apply the same lens. Most of the insight stayed locked in recordings. The bottleneck wasn’t having things to say—it was turning conversations into content.

The workflow

One system, two pipelines

RocketSaaS built two separate Rightbrain workflows, each routing a different call type to a different destination. Both run automatically via Fathom the moment a call ends.

Pipeline 1: Discovery calls → content engine

When a discovery call completes, an agent pulls the transcript and extracts structured insight: why the prospect is in market, how they heard about RocketSaaS, which channels they care about, the challenges they face, and what that signals about broader market trends.

Each extraction goes into a structured Google Sheets repository, building over time into a dataset of every discovery conversation the team has had. A second agent runs across this dataset to identify patterns: which problems recur, which channels are gaining momentum, and what language prospects use to describe their pain.

Those insights feed content ideation—posts, podcast episodes, and newsletter angles—on brand and consistent every time, with tone of voice and brand guidelines baked into the agent from the start.

Workflow:

  • Fathom → Agent extracts themes → Google Sheets repository → Trend analysis → Content ideas

Pipeline 2: Client calls → ops and strategy

When a kick-off or strategy call ends, a separate workflow routes the transcript into ops. Action items are extracted and pushed to Slack as notifications, ensuring nothing from the call falls through the cracks.

This pipeline also feeds into client Notion workspaces and Google Docs, building strategy documentation, next steps, and follow-up material directly from the call rather than from scratch.

Workflow:

  • Fathom → Agent extracts actions → Slack notification → Notion / Google Docs

The content team still does a final review pass before anything is published. Now they are editing and choosing—not staring at a blank page.

What changed

  • Every call is now analysed. Before, the team reviewed roughly five calls per month only when someone had time. Now every call is processed automatically with no manual triggering.
  • Outputs are consistent. The same structure, the same categories, and the same brand voice are applied to every call. No more variation or prompt drift.
  • Jamie’s time moved upstream. Hours previously spent on manual extraction now go to what requires strategic judgement—spotting trends across the dataset, shaping the content narrative, and deciding what the business needs to say next.
  • The team now has a searchable repository of structured insight from every discovery call—a queryable dataset that feeds into quarterly trend analysis and market positioning.
  • Content quality and consistency have improved. Better insight in means better content out, with a direct impact on engagement and inbound demo bookings.
  • From five calls reviewed monthly → every call analysed
  • Always on—pipeline runs in the background with zero manual triggering
  • Five hours saved each month from manual extraction work

We spend a huge amount of time on calls. There’s so much good data in them, but it was always in an unstructured format. This takes that unstructured data and turns it into part of our core workflows.

— Joe Mclaughlin, Account Director at Rocket SaaS

What’s next

Extending the pipeline into client delivery

The discovery-to-content pipeline proved the model. RocketSaaS is building a third workflow that takes the same approach deeper into client delivery.

In development: Kick-off call → strategy and onboarding

When a new client kick-off call ends, the agent will take the transcript alongside the kick-off document and begin strategy preparation automatically: pulling together research, drafting the initial messaging framework, starting the audit, and creating and assigning onboarding tasks in Asana, getting access requests out, setting up workspaces, and briefing the right people.

The account director arrives at the strategy stage with a brief already built and the admin already handled, instead of spending the first week assembling inputs manually. The same system. A different call type. A different destination. Running in the background.

Who this is for

Any agency that wants to get more insight from calls without manual work. This workflow applies anywhere a team runs a high volume of discovery, strategy, client, or internal calls and finds that the insight rarely makes it further than the recording.

It’s particularly effective for agencies and service businesses where the people with the most context—heads of strategy, account directors, senior consultants—are also the ones doing ad hoc manual extraction work. Automating that layer frees them to do what requires their expertise.

If your team already uses Fathom, Notion, Slack, or Google Docs, there’s nothing new to learn. The pipeline runs inside the tools you already use.

How else are marketing agencies using Rightbrain?

With Rightbrain, it’s about stacking different agents on the path to becoming AI-native. Examples agencies are building:

  • CRM enrichment: all new leads are automatically enriched to provide context for marketing and sales.
  • ABM: enriching account lists to be used for more accurate targeting in client ad accounts and tailored, automated outreach campaigns.

See this running in your stack

We’ll map your current call workflow and build the first pipeline with you in a single session. Book at https://rightbrain.ai/demo.
